system.name: ContextDialog
system.one_liner: A benchmark testing whether voice interaction models recall earlier utterances, built from MultiDialog by generating, validating and voicing past-recall QA.

content.variant_note: three titled panels left to right: source dialogue, written-form QA generation and validation, spoken QA synthesis and verification, with the finished spoken QA bubbles hanging below
content.argues: ContextDialog is built by turning existing spoken dialogues into verified written past-recall QA, then into speaker-adaptive spoken QA checked automatically and by humans.
content.subject: a spoken dialogue turned into written QA by two LLM prompts, then into spoken QA with TTS and verification

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw a data-construction pipeline as titled stage panels with one icon and one model logo per step, and end with the finished sample as speech bubbles outside the frame, so the reader sees both the process and what one entry of the benchmark looks like.
lessons.suits: benchmark or dataset papers whose data come from chained LLM and tool steps (generate, validate, synthesise, verify) and whose entries are conversations.

evidence: ContextDialog is constructed using MultiDialog (Park et al., 2024), a spoken dialog corpus featuring conversations between two speakers
then converted to speech via adaptive TTS and verified both automatically and manually

summary: ContextDialog is a benchmark for testing whether voice interaction models can recall what was said earlier in a conversation. Figure 1 shows how it is built from MultiDialog, a corpus of spoken two-speaker dialogues. Three blue-framed panels read left to right. The first shows a multi-round dialogue as speech bubbles between two cartoon speakers, and a curly brace passes it to Stage 1, where GPT-4o with a generation prompt writes past-recall QA pairs and o1-mini with a validation prompt checks them, joined by a block arrow. Stage 2 turns the validated QA into speech with speaker-adaptive TTS and verifies pronunciation automatically and by humans. The finished spoken question and answer hang below as two bubbles with loudspeaker icons.
summary_zh: ContextDialog 用来检验语音助手能否记住前文。图一分三个蓝框面板：先是双人多轮语音对话，经 GPT-4o 生成、o1-mini 校验得到书面问答，再用说话人自适应 TTS 合成语音并经自动与人工核查，最后给出语音问答气泡。
notes: Prior kind stage-pipeline (data-construction) kept; worked-walkthrough added because the same music conversation runs from the source dialogue to the final question and answer. No arrows join Stage 1 to Stage 2 or the two boxes inside Stage 2; order comes from the titles and the layout. Whether the bubble texts are verbatim dataset items is not stated; they are marked as real values on the strength of their transcript-like wording. All ten bitmaps are icons, so pictures is empty.
